preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised owner account)
Bouns distribution must be active (bounsTime must be reached)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As owner, call sumBounsPiece() with an extremely large number (e.g., type(uint256).max) for the current day's date string. This will set dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] to a value greater than dayPoolBouns[yesToday]. Then when any user calls receiveBounsToken(), the _sumCanGetToken() function will attempt to subtract dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday].mul(balancePiece) from dayPoolBouns[yesToday], causing a subtraction overflow revert due to SafeMath's require(b <= a) check. This permanently disables the bonus distribution mechanism.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is an owner privilege abuse in the LoveDoge contract. The owner can call sumBounsPiece() with an arbitrarily large number to set dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] to a value greater than dayPoolBouns[yesToday]. When users later call receiveBounsToken(), the _sumCanGetToken() function will attempt to subtract dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday].mul(balancePiece) from dayPoolBouns[yesToday], causing a SafeMath subtraction overflow revert (require(b <= a)). This permanently disables the bonus distribution mechanism. The oracle verification checks that dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] > dayPoolBouns[yesToday] after the exploit.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank. 2. Ensure bounsTime is reached (or set it to current time). 3. Get the yesterday's date string (yesToday) using the contract's getDays() function. 4. Call sumBounsPiece() with an extremely large number (type(uint256).max) as owner. 5. Verify that dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] > dayPoolBouns[yesToday].
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. In setUp(), identify the contract owner address (likely the deployer). 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Optionally set bounsTime to current timestamp if needed. 4. Call getDays() to get yesToday string. 5. Call sumBounsPiece(yesToday, type(uint256).max) as owner. 6. Verify the state change: assert(dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] > dayPoolBouns[yesToday]).
